own_solution.law: Resolve the initial velocity into Cartesian components: v_Ay = v_A sin(theta) = 20.0 sin(30.0 degrees) = 10.0 m/s, upward.
assumptions: The vertical axis points upward, perpendicular to the stated horizontal.
The launch speed and angle describe the same velocity in the same reference frame.

notes: All four variants give an initial vertical velocity of 10.0 m/s upward. Projectile B's speed is structurally disconnected (D): B is in another test range and explicitly never interacts with A. The variants change only B's speed, retaining the same unit and attachment. The explicit unrelated-projectile statement makes the presentation slightly artificial.
